name: Coin Moebius Buy Button
author: coinmoebius

sections.description:
Sell without limits. The buy button for your website. Take cards, crypto, and gold with one button. The money goes to your account or wallet, never through us.

This plugin puts that buy button on your WordPress site without any code. Connect your Coin Moebius store once, then pick a product from a list wherever you want a button.

  • A block for the block editor. Add the Coin Moebius Buy Button block and choose a product.
  • A shortcode for every other editor. Classic editor, Divi, WPBakery, and any builder that takes shortcodes.
  • An Elementor widget. Drag in the buy button or the cart.
  • A cart when you want one. Turn the cart on in your Coin Moebius dashboard, then add the Cart block to your header or show it in a menu.
  • A button that matches your site. Use your theme’s button colors, corners, and font in one click on a block theme, or pick them yourself.
  • Works with speed plugins. The button’s script is left alone by WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, Autoptimize, and SiteGround Optimizer, so it loads every time.

You need a Coin Moebius account and a store with at least one product. Create your account at https://app.coinmoebius.com/signup. Your products, prices, and payment providers stay in your Coin Moebius dashboard. This plugin only places the buttons and styles them.

How the connection stays safe

When you connect, you sign in to Coin Moebius and pick a store. Coin Moebius then gives this site its own key. That key can only read your product list. It cannot take payments, see your sales, or change your store. The key is stored encrypted, and disconnecting cancels it right away.

External services

This plugin connects to Coin Moebius, the service that runs your buy button, checkout, and store.

  • Connecting your store. When you press Connect, your browser opens app.coinmoebius.com so you can sign in and pick a store. Your site then sends a one-time code to api.coinmoebius.com and receives the key for your store.
  • Your product list. Your site sends that key to api.coinmoebius.com to read your product names and prices. This happens when you open the plugin’s settings or the editor, and at most once every 10 minutes. No information about your visitors is sent.
  • The buy button. Pages with a buy button or cart load the button from sdk.coinmoebius.com. When a shopper opens the button, their browser talks to api.coinmoebius.com to show your payment choices and start the checkout they pick.
  • Disconnecting. When you disconnect or delete the plugin, your site tells api.coinmoebius.com to cancel its key.

Coin Moebius terms: https://www.coinmoebius.com/terms
Coin Moebius privacy policy: https://www.coinmoebius.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Coin Moebius in your WordPress menu and press Connect to Coin Moebius.
  3. Sign in, pick your store, and press Connect. You come right back to WordPress.
  4. Add the Coin Moebius Buy Button block, the shortcode, or the Elementor widget to any page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Coin Moebius account?

Yes. You add products and connect your payment providers in your Coin Moebius dashboard. This plugin shows those products as buttons on your site. Create one at https://app.coinmoebius.com/signup.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. The buy button is its own checkout, so WooCommerce and other store plugins can stay off.

My browser does not come back to WordPress after I connect.

Open Coin Moebius in your WordPress menu, choose Connect with a code instead, and follow the steps. You copy a code from the connect page and paste it into WordPress.

Does it work on WordPress.com?

Yes, on WordPress.com plans that allow plugins.
